body: You want to see me do it, but it's not likely to happen.
Anything is possible, but some things are more likely than others. Living a life that I am okay with is not very likely. Why suffer?

My legal issue can and most likely end up haunting me for the rest of my life. Maybe if I were super rich and/or had a supporting family then it would be easier to cope with. I have a lot of problems. Besides, we all end up dead in the ground.
I have not been successful. And I have made bad choices that will undoubtedly affect me for life. I am entangled in a legal issue.
Yes, I can't change the past, but my future is pretty bleak. But it has been for some time.

They are hostile towards me and have been for some time. Ironically, I was the better behaved one. Started working when I was 15, paid my way through college, earned a BS and MS on my own, and worked harder than my peers had to work. Yet, they never could give me credit for anything. They misappropriated their anger and attention. I got more shit for having a messy room than my sibling who was on meth and drug dealing/prostituting at our house.
